howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Simple, transparent, and compassionate. Three easy steps to make a real difference.

step1.title: Verified Requests
step1.description: All donation requests are carefully reviewed and verified by our admin team to ensure legitimacy and genuine need.

step2.title: Anonymous Donation
step2.description: Donate anonymously or publicly. Your choice. No judgment, no pressure. Every contribution is valued equally.

step3.title: Tracked Delivery
step3.description: Follow your donation from start to finish. See exactly how your contribution helps and where it goes.

whoWeServe.title: Who We Serve
whoWeServe.subtitle: A platform built for everyone who wants to share, give, and make a difference.

donor.title: Donor
donor.description: Make a difference with confidence. Browse verified requests, donate anonymously or publicly, and track your impact.

receiver.title: Receiver
receiver.description: Submit your verified request for help. Receive support with dignity and respect, maintaining your privacy.

admin.title: Admin
admin.description: Manage the platform with transparency. Verify requests, monitor donations, and ensure trust throughout the system.

trust.title: Trust & Transparency
trust.subtitle: We believe in complete transparency. Every request is verified, every donation is tracked, and every process is open.

verified.title: Verified Requests Only
verified.description: All donation requests go through a thorough verification process. We ensure that every need is genuine and legitimate before it goes live.

tracking.title: Full Tracking & Reporting
tracking.description: See exactly where your donation goes. Track the entire journey from your contribution to the final delivery, with complete transparency.

privacy.title: Privacy Protected
privacy.description: Your privacy matters. Donate anonymously, request help discreetly, and maintain your dignity throughout the process.

noJudgment.title: No Judgment Policy
noJudgment.description: Whether you give $5 or $5000, every donation is equally valued. We create a judgment-free environment for both donors and receivers.

cta.title: Ready to Make a Difference?
cta.subtitle: Join our community of donors and receivers. Together, we can create positive change with dignity and trust.

footer.description: A transparent donation platform built on trust, dignity, and respect. Give with confidence, help with compassion.
